data_fields.name: room_first_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: same-room candidate beats other-room best; nearer wins within class

best_idea: Pick the enemy in the same room before a closer one in another room, and keep an aggro memory that holds at full while the enemy is seen and counts down to zero when it is not.
decision_why: The room-first rule makes zones matter for aggro and the seen-then-count-down memory is a plain hysteresis for our fight loop; adapt because the donor refreshes at animation boundaries and wake-up rather than a fixed tick, needs a region map we would have to define, and its monster-vs-monster rules are not ours.
acceptance: Server test: a zone NPC with a hero in its room at distance 6 and another hero in an adjacent room at distance 2 picks the room hero; after the room hero leaves sight the NPC stays aggro for 255 ticks and then drops it (fixed seed, tick log asserted).
